Fees are paid by honor system at the box south of the restroom and shower building. The west-side back-in sites close for the Chanute Recreation Commission's Summer Fest in early August (August 5-8 as posted).

note: City of Chanute campground in Santa Fe Park, in two lots: 18 paved sites at the north-west corner of South Santa Fe Ave and Chanute 35 Parkway, and 8 back-in sites on the west side across the road from the restroom and shower building. Santa Fe Lake is at the north end of the park, about 500 m from the sites. Tents may camp free for up to 2 nights on the grass south of the restrooms. --Claude
